variants.label: JVM (Java 25, JIT)
variants.rationale: The baseline everything else is compared against, and the only build that JIT-compiles from a profile gathered during the run itself.

variants.label: JVM (G1, C1 only)
variants.rationale: Isolates the collector: G1 against the baseline's serial, JIT held at C1.

variants.label: JVM (serial GC, full tiering)
variants.rationale: Isolates the JIT: C2 restored, collector held at the baseline's serial.

variants.label: JVM (G1, full tiering)
variants.rationale: The JVM as it would be deployed on more than one core, and the only JVM build that meets native-o3-g1 on equal terms.
